    - heading "Understand Angle" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "An angle measures the amount of turn between two rays with a common endpoint. In Angle, that statement is the exact rule used on the labelled chart and in the three numerical examples. A useful rule is Full turn: 360 degrees. You can learn Angle by trying one small example instead of long theory."
    - paragraph: Identify the vertex. Identify the two rays. Measure the turn from one ray to the other. Try the example below. Write your steps and choose an answer before opening the comparison.
    - paragraph: "In real life, clock hands: Hands form angles. Watch out: Thinking longer rays make a bigger angle. Angle depends on turn, not ray length."
